purpose: Single internal registry of canonical project assets, sources, approved UI baselines and data-flow rules.

definitive_site.rule: All future site work starts from this file or from an explicitly approved successor.

canonical_card.rule: Preserve the approved Card V2 structure and behavior unless explicitly changed by the user.

shobi_master.role: Normalized personal master database populated from official Shobi data and approved enrichment.
shobi_master.rule: Canonical perfume-level values belong here before being propagated to runtime/site outputs.

shobi_bestsellers.source: Official Shobi Sales, highest to lowest ordering
shobi_bestsellers.rule: Best Seller Rank is acquired from Shobi ordering and written into shobi-master.csv.

site_runtime.rule: Runtime is a generated delivery layer and must not supersede the master CSV as source of truth.

source_documentation.role: Documents source provenance and acquisition rules.

operating_rules: Read this registry before structural changes, rebuilds or migrations.
Do not treat root index.html or index-v2.html as the definitive site unless the user explicitly promotes them.
Do not duplicate canonical data into a second competing master source.
Derived files may be regenerated; canonical sources and approved design references must be preserved.
When a new definitive version is approved, update this registry immediately.
